# RefinedType {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
RefinedType
```
Abstract supertype for the refined classification schemes of spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs); see Weiß and Kim (2025). Concrete subtypes are [`RotationType`](@ref), [`DirectionType`](@ref), and [`DiagonalType`](@ref).
 


:::
